bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs (context_menu, ContextAction); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (Files app context menu); springboard/src/files/fs.rs (Files operations); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (document grants)
summary: Apple's framework is one extension point: a File Provider extension adds actions to the long-press context menu of its own files in the system document browser, and shows a custom view controller to finish each action. BifrOSt has no File Provider extension, no action extension for the Files browser, and no file provider domain. It has a generic context menu for app-owned items and a fixed set of Files operations, so an app cannot add actions to Files.

gaps: No extension point through which a third-party app adds actions to the Files browser's item context menu (the core of this framework).
No hosted extension process that shows a custom action UI over the Files browser and completes or cancels a selected action.

The system browser does not list an app's own files as a browsable location. The domain model exists (springboard/sdk/src/file_provider.rs, Domain and DomainRegistry, tests file_provider::tests), but Files does not use it.
No typed system action identifiers that apps can register or receive for file actions.
No authentication-error hand-off for file actions against remote or cloud providers.
